name: Minamiboso (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Minamiboso city emblem in pink and green: a pink flower of five petals with a green leaf.
history: Municipal flag of Minamiboso, a city in Chiba Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 20 March 2006.

features.role: Minamiboso city emblem — a pink flower of five petals with a green leaf
